title: Corporator content pack
description: Normative schema for every file under content/params, content/strings and content/fixtures. Language-neutral on purpose: the server and the public verifier (DESIGN.md 6.3) must agree on validity without sharing an implementation language.

src.description: Canon reference the value follows from. Acceptance criterion: no number without a source.

why.description: Justification in prose. Enforced by length so that 'ok' does not pass.

v.description: Integer only. Rates live in basis points so that no float ever reaches the hashed pack.

derived_map.description: Names of values that must NOT be stored anywhere in params. Rule L09 checks both directions against the generator.

price_feed.description: One external price input to the mint-rate path. L27 requires a state code, a TWAP window and a staleness limit; L29 requires a downward decay so a dead feed cannot hold a poisoned ceiling.

studio_eth_recipient.description: Cold EOA for the studio take from the prize DEX leg. Empty until the owner address is recorded. Not a contract.

launch_deployed.description: Post-factum pons addresses. Empty until the signed launch lands. Partial fill is L279.

district_stake.description: S_min is stored in tokens after a dated feed snapshot. Empty snapshot is honest: do not invent prices. S_ref is not stored; it equals S_min.

modifier_applies_when.description: When a trait or objective row applies. Night premium and district efficiency are state, not rows.

templates.description: Name and blurb templates. Not failure codes: L11 compares strings to codes only.

ui.description: Interface copy. Not failure codes: L11 compares strings to codes only. L146 checks screens labels against this map.

state_source_id.description: Owner registry key: family.leaf, not a stored magnitude.

producer.description: Tick or host function that produces this live magnitude. Required for owner T11 (L222 next wave).

sim_archetype.description: One play-style row. A fourth archetype is a new key here; tick.py and sim.py iterate the map and do not name the three canon rows.

bind.description: Maps a scenario field to an existing param path so T1/T2 numbers are not copied.

description: Root is never validated directly; lint.py picks the matching $defs entry per file. Kept as an object so the document itself stays a valid schema.
